releases.name: Money for Girls: Amortized
releases.summary: Fashion. Corruption. Malice. A girl detective faces her darkest mystery yet, in this horror-romance visual novel with stickers, outfits, and bad ends.

releases.name: Ghost of Kyiv
releases.summary: Become the Ghost of Kyiv and defend your homeland from the enemy invasion! In this 2D bullet-hell shooter, dodge enemies and upgrade 5 unique stats in order to defend against constant waves of enemies that only get stronger. Can you defeat all 5 bosses and reclaim your homeland?

releases.name: Tridan
releases.summary: Push your luck in a fast-paced 3-card poker roguelite. Spin the wheel of fortune for powerful bonuses, risky drawbacks, and endless combinations as you chase your highest round.

releases.name: Lumina:Last Bloom
releases.summary: Lumina: Last Bloom is an atmosphere-focused short adventure game about spending the final seven days with a girl afflicted by the mysterious “Hanazaki Disease.” Explore a quiet fantasy world, uncover memories through conversations, and experience an emotional story told through pixel-art visuals.

releases.name: Crack That Smile
releases.summary: A punchy, low-effort incremental game where you hover over frozen ice to shatter it and free adorable emojis. Upgrade your freezing-crushing power, break harder ice, feel invincible, and rescue every emoji collection in this short, packed game!

releases.name: A Border With No End
releases.summary: A Border with No End is a horrorpunk adventure RPG set right in the middle of your normal everyday insanity, psychotic depression and a surreal nightmare, that is both meaningless and interpretive. Fight for nothing and loose it all.

releases.name: Neon Cadence
releases.summary: Neon Cadence is a synthwave keyboard rhythm game. Tap D F J K to 30 original tracks across J-pop, K-pop, English and instrumental styles, with gold taps, wide notes, holds, glide sweeps and RUSH zones over three difficulties. Open-ended scoring and D-to-SSS ranks reward every clean run.

releases.name: Peg Champ
releases.summary: Take your best shot in this Pachinko puzzle game! Break all the red pegs to win, but be careful you don't run out of shots. Earn money and fill out a huge upgrade tree on your journey to become the Peg Champ!

releases.name: Prospector Peril
releases.summary: Mine down into an active volcano, grab what valuables you can and make your escape before it erupts!

releases.name: DARKLING
releases.summary: DARKLING is a bite-sized first-person horror game. Locked inside a haunted house, use your wits to get out.
